title: Interest Crediting Band Schedule: Large Whole Life Insurance Accumulation Deposits
content:
The annual rate credited on the dividend accumulation deposit of an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy is the declared accumulation rate raised for a large deposit. The deposit is judged as the policy ledger totals it on the day the credit is processed: the dividends placed on deposit plus the interest credited less the withdrawals, totalled from the dividend deposit, interest credit and accumulation withdrawal entries.

| Ledger-totalled deposit on the processing day (USD) | Rate credited raised by |
|---|---|
| 25000 or more | 0.50 percentage point (0.005) |
| 10000 or more, below 25000 | 0.25 percentage point (0.0025) |
| Below 10000 | Not raised |

The increase is added to the rate in percentage points.

**Band edges (hypothetical, declared rate 3.75%).** A ledger total of 25000.00 is credited at 4.25%; 24999.99 at 4.00%; 10000.00 at 4.00%; 9999.99 at 3.75%. The band follows the ledger total, which can differ from the balance shown on the policy record.
